currency.basis: Live Finuslugi bank-profile SVG and currently bank-published app updated 2026-09-14 support this emblem and gold/charcoal brand family for operating bank.

identity.basis: Finuslugi explicitly labels the source bank, links metadata host and identifies licence 3001; official-published app lists exact legal publisher.

assessment.independenceRationale: Finuslugi bank-profile editorial vector and bank-published RuStore application are separate publication groups; duplicated app references are not counted as independent corroboration.
uncertainties: Corporate website access blocked; no claim that burgundy/white has universally ceased use.
Official app uses gold emblem on charcoal, while Finuslugi source uses charcoal emblem on gold field; candidate retains its supported source presentation, not an invented blend.

variant.basis: Exact independent source viewport is a complete standalone bank symbol with no separate lettering, gold gradient field and charcoal emblem. This inverse presentation is published by Finuslugi, not synthesized from app artwork. Regular high-precision compound geometry and off-canvas original lockup letterforms support original vector rather than a raster trace.

candidate.detailsJudgement: Inspected full original raster and exact source/final Compose pairs on both themes: outer lobes, oval apertures, triangular and teardrop apertures intact. Charcoal and gold gradient match; no lettering, clipping or invented elements.
candidate.proportionsJudgement: Exact Compose final preserves original oval aspect, placement and complete contours inside the source square. Useful centered size and legibility on both themes; retained complex gradient backing is source-faithful.
candidate.rationale: Live bank-labelled Finuslugi original vector provides source-backed gold/charcoal standalone presentation, corroborated at emblem/color-family level by current bank-published app updated 2026-09-14. Meaningful gold/charcoal versus burgundy/white difference, not a serialization-only update; no claim old corporate burgundy ceased all use.
candidate.role: Standalone symmetric bank emblem within declared square source viewport; no accompanying text visible.
transforms: Preserved original 40×40 source viewport and complete visible emblem geometry/colors/alpha; no scale, translation, recoloring, tracing or backing adaptation. Retained source square because field is complex gradient/compositing rather than separable uniform fill, per icon-background.md §1. Off-canvas full-lockup lettering remains invisible outside original viewport.

Source square retained due complex gradient/compositing; no automatic circular adaptation.
candidate.visibleDiffExplanation: Exact before/after Compose pairs on both themes show white emblem on burgundy circle replaced by charcoal emblem on pale-gold gradient square. This is a source-backed color/presentation correction, not proof old variant ceased all use.

proposals.reason: A source-supported standalone original vector is available from the live Finuslugi bank profile; its charcoal/pale-gold presentation differs visibly from accepted burgundy/white and is corroborated at color-family and complete emblem level by the bank-published current gold/charcoal app icon. This is a proposed evidenced variant correction, not a claim the burgundy corporate variant has conclusively disappeared.
